scene_description: A wide, elegant shot inside a luxurious, high-ceilinged home with marble floors. Three movers in pristine black one-piece overalls (showing minimal, professional exertion) are carefully lifting a heavy, blanket-wrapped grand piano onto a specialized piano skid. The blankets are strapped tightly, and tape is used only to secure the outer protective layers. Large floor-to-ceiling windows cast soft, diffused natural light across the room.
visual_details: Lifting wrapped grand piano onto skid, luxury home interior, marble floors, unbranded black overalls, careful teamwork, blankets and straps, soft diffused natural light, high-end professional move, documentary style.
camera_settings: Shot on Fujifilm Pro 400H, 35mm lens, f/4.0, 1/125 sec, ISO 400. Soft, elegant lighting, wide composition.

scene_description: A close-up, focused photograph in a wealthy residential bedroom. An experienced mover in a black overall is delicately wrapping a large, ornate gilded mirror. He has applied a layer of specialized moving paper and is wrapping it in thick bubble wrap. He meticulously applies brown tape to the plastic wrap only, ensuring the delicate frame is protected. Warm sunlight filters through sheer curtains. The focus is strictly on his careful technique.
visual_details: Wrapping ornate mirror, luxury bedroom, unbranded black overalls, bubble wrap, tape strictly on plastic, delicate/expert handling, warm natural sunlight, tight focus on technique, candid documentary.
camera_settings: Shot on Kodak Portra 400, 85mm lens, f/2.0, 1/160 sec, ISO 200. Shallow depth of field, warm ambient light.

scene_description: An outdoor shot on the expansive patio of a luxurious, modern estate. A mover in a black one-piece overall is pushing a dolly loaded with heavy, wrapped outdoor lounge furniture toward a manicured driveway. The mover shows a realistic sweat sheen under the bright, clear sky. In the background, an unmarked, large enclosed moving truck is parked. The scene conveys high-end service combined with hard physical labor.
visual_details: Pushing dolly with wrapped patio furniture, luxury home exterior, unbranded black overalls, sweat under bright sun, unmarked truck in background, high-end residential move, clear daylight, documentary style.
camera_settings: Shot on Fujifilm Velvia 50, f/8.0, 1/400 sec. High contrast, bright sunny conditions, vibrant but realistic colors.

scene_description: A dramatic low-angle shot looking up a sweeping, curved wooden staircase in a luxury home. Two movers in black overalls are carefully carrying a massive, heavy antique wooden armoire down the steps. The armoire is fully protected in grey moving blankets secured with straps. The movers' faces show intense concentration and controlled effort. Natural light from a high chandelier window illuminates the scene, casting long shadows.
visual_details: Carrying wrapped antique armoire down curved staircase, luxury home, unbranded black overalls, intense focus/effort, moving blankets and straps, low angle, dramatic natural light, candid documentary.
camera_settings: Shot on Tri-X 400 film, 24mm lens, f/4.0, 1/100 sec, ISO 800. Dramatic lighting, deep shadows, pronounced grain.

scene_description: A candid shot in the large, minimalist kitchen of a luxury home. A mover in a black overall is carefully packing delicate glassware into a specialized, partitioned cardboard box. The counter is covered in wrapping paper and unmarked boxes. The mover is focused and methodical. Sunlight gleams off the high-end marble countertops. The scene captures the careful, quieter side of premium moving services.
visual_details: Packing glassware into partitioned boxes, luxury minimalist kitchen, unbranded black overalls, focused/methodical work, wrapping paper, marble countertops, bright natural light, documentary style.
camera_settings: Shot on Kodak Portra 160, f/4.0, 1/125 sec, ISO 160. Clean, bright lighting, crisp focus.

scene_description: A raw, candid portrait of a South African mover taking a brief water break. He is sitting on the lowered tailgate of an unmarked moving truck parked on a suburban street. He wears an unbranded black one-piece overall that shows dust from the day's work. He is drinking from a plastic water bottle, wiping sweat from his brow. The truck behind him is fully loaded with unmarked boxes and wrapped furniture. Authentic, gritty documentary feel.
visual_details: Sweaty mover resting on truck tailgate, drinking water, unbranded black overalls with dust, fully loaded unmarked truck, suburban street, realistic fatigue, raw documentary portrait, film grain.
camera_settings: Shot on Kodak Portra 800, 50mm lens, f/2.8, 1/200 sec. Handheld, noticeable grain, focus on the subject's face.

scene_description: A documentary photograph capturing teamwork in a narrow residential hallway. Three movers in black overalls are struggling but coordinating effectively to maneuver a massive, heavily wrapped American-style double-door fridge around a tight corner. Hands are gripping the straps tightly, and their postures show extreme physical leverage. The walls are plain white, and the lighting is standard ambient home lighting. No branding anywhere.
visual_details: Three movers maneuvering massive wrapped fridge around tight hallway corner, unbranded black overalls, extreme leverage and coordination, tight space, moving straps, candid documentary action.
camera_settings: Shot on Fujifilm Pro 400H, 24mm lens, f/4.0, 1/60 sec, ISO 1600. Wide angle to capture the tight space, grainy low-light texture.

scene_description: An establishing shot of an active move. An unmarked, large white moving truck is backed into the driveway of a standard suburban house. Two movers in black overalls are walking down the truck's metal ramp carrying an empty dolly, heading back into the house for another load. The midday sun creates strong shadows. The scene is quiet but industrious, capturing the repetitive flow of the job.
visual_details: Movers walking down truck ramp with empty dolly, unmarked white truck, suburban driveway, unbranded black overalls, industrious flow, bright midday sun, strong shadows, documentary style.
camera_settings: Shot on Kodak Ektar 100, f/8.0, 1/500 sec. Sharp, daylight balanced, high resolution film look.

scene_description: Inside a garage that is being cleared out. A mover in a black overall is rolling a stack of four heavy winter tires toward the driveway. The garage is dusty, and the mover's overall shows a realistic amount of garage grime. The light is a mix of dim overhead bulbs and bright sunlight spilling in from the open garage door. The image captures the less glamorous, heavy-lifting aspect of residential moves.
visual_details: Rolling heavy tires out of a dusty garage, unbranded black overalls with minor grime, realistic exertion, mixed garage lighting and bright sunlight, candid documentary style.
camera_settings: Shot on Tri-X 400, f/5.6, 1/125 sec, ISO 800. High contrast, raw texture, capturing the transition from dark to light.

scene_description: The final moments of a moving job. A mover in a black one-piece overall stands at the rear of a fully loaded, unmarked moving truck, pulling down the heavy metal roller door. The truck is packed tight with generic boxes and blanket-wrapped furniture. The mover is sweaty and visibly tired, looking up at the door as he pulls it down. The streetlamps are just starting to turn on in the twilight, casting a cool, dusky light over the scene.
visual_details: Mover pulling down truck roller door, fully loaded unmarked truck, unbranded black overalls, sweaty/tired, end of the day, twilight lighting, streetlamps turning on, raw documentary conclusion.
camera_settings: Shot on Cinestill 800T, f/2.8, 1/60 sec. Cool twilight tones, slight halation from streetlamps, grainy cinematic feel.
